title: Vector-similarity quickstart visual kit & annotated screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, production-ready visual kit for the Vector Similarity + Result Ordering quickstart that will ship in the docs and Console release. Deliverables include a simple pipeline diagram (desktop + mobile variants), a three-card example outputs set (golden outputs for high/medium/low relevance), annotated screenshot overlays for the Console Quickstart flow, and a small set of exportable assets (SVGs / 2x PNGs) for marketing/docs.

Scope and constraints: Keep the flow to a single-screen onboarding for first-time users: 1) ingest/vectorize 2) query + scoring 3) return ordered results. Avoid complex architecture diagrams — visuals must be readable at doc width (max 680px) and as a 1080px social asset. Assets must be color-accessible (WCAG AA contrast), support light/dark Console themes, and be localizable (text layers preserved in Figma).

Design decisions / trade-offs: We opted for a linear left-to-right pipeline instead of an exploded multi-node diagram to reduce cognitive load for new users. We will show a simplified KV-cache icon (single rectangle with lightning bolt) rather than full cache internals to prevent infra-level noise. Sample outputs are stylized cards (title, 1-line excerpt, score badge) rather than full chat transcripts to make reranking behavior obvious.

Acceptance criteria: Visuals exported and reviewed; Figma file with named layers and localization frames; Desktop pipeline and mobile adaptation exported (SVG + PNG@2x); Three annotated Console screenshots with callouts and copy; Designer and PM sign-off; Engineering acceptance of assets for doc embed and Console UI integration (PR linked).

Handoff notes: Provide a partial CSS token list for badges (colors, border-radius, spacing) and a short spec for responsive breakpoint at 640px. Keep copy variableized so i18n team can extract strings.

Accessible considerations: All icons must have text alternatives in documentation and contrast ratio tested. Use color + shape for score badges (number + colored ring) so color-blind users can parse relevance.

Where to review assets: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Vector-Quickstart-Visuals, Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e_VectorQuickstart, Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Vector+Quickstart+PRD

Primary links for implementation: GitHub PR for Console embedding: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2345
